sloka: इति सान्वैश्च तीक्ष्णै कैकेयीम् राजसम्सदि ।सुवन्त्रः क्षोभयामास भूय एव कृताञ्जलिः ॥२-३५-३६॥
transliteration: iti sānvaiśca tīkṣṇai kaikeyīm rājasamsadi ।suvantraḥ kṣobhayāmāsa bhūya eva kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥2-35-36॥

translations.english: With soothing words and with sharp ones, Sumantra with joined palms sought again and again to shake Kaikeyi in the royal assembly.
